P092.title: Identification of wheel-rail forces on high-speed railways based on physical model and hybrid recursive neural networks
P092.authors: H Liu, L Song, L Xu, Z Yu
P092.label: Liu等（2025）

complete_examples.text: For this purpose, a calibrated vehicle-track physical model is used to generate vehicle vibration data and wheel-rail forces, and a data-driven hybrid recursive convolutional and long short-term neural network (CNN-LSTM) and forward rolling prediction method based on recursive mechanisms is developed to facilitate the inversion of wheel-rail forces.

Vehicle-track system Hybrid recursive CNN-LSTM Wheel-rail force Inversion identification Variational mode decomposition A B S T R A C T This paper aims to propose a practical framework for fast inversion and identification of wheel-rail forces of railway based on deep learning, with a view of achieving continuous measurement of the wheel-rail forces of the entire railway line in real time by means of the easily-measure vibration response of the train.
